'''Meldina''' was a [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] rock [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with no [[Moon/Legends|moons]] that occupied the second closest [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position to the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Abo]]. It was located within the [[Lehon system]], a part of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions']] area known as the [[Tempered Wastes]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Meldina was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]] [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Meldina, in grid square G-11.<ref name="TEA" />
